analyst.summary: CP Plus (Aditya Infotech), India's leading CCTV/surveillance brand, listed on the exchange less than a year ago and had shown strong growth through March 2026. However, the most recently reported quarter (June 2026) shows a sharp reversal - revenue and profit both fell versus the prior quarter and versus a year earlier - which is not yet reflected in this stock's growth scores. Combined with a still-rich valuation and the fact that some of the company's earlier standout profit growth came from a one-off non-operating item rather than the core business, this is a name whose next couple of quarters matter more than usual for confirming whether the recent strength was durable.
